```yaml
name: Release Beta

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write
  packages: write

jobs:
  release-beta:
    name: Release Beta
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 20
          registry-url: https://registry.npmjs.org

      - name: Setup Devbox
        uses: jetify-com/devbox-install@v0.10.2

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: devbox run --config=shells/devbox-fast.json -- npm ci

      - name: Create beta branch pointer
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git checkout -b beta
          git push origin beta --force

      - name: Run semantic-release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          cd "$PROJECT_ROOT"
          devbox run --config=shells/devbox-fast.json -- npx multi-semantic-release \
            --branches="beta" \
            --tag="beta" \
            --dry-run=false

      - name: Clean up beta branch
        if: always()
        run: |
          git push origin --delete beta || true
```
